name: Transforming
body:
Price +5 bonus; Slot weapon quality; CL 9th Weight –; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This functions as a wild armor, except it preserves its armor bonus (and any enhancement bonus) while the wearer is in a different form, whether it is from the wild shape ability, a spell, a spell-like ability, the change shape ability, or another source. While the wearer is in a different shape, the armor cannot be seen.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells polymorph
